customProviders.description: The judge (ADR 0230): Jev's typed decisions at /v1/systemone. Inert without a key: BYOK with --provider-key typesafe=…, or the TYPESAFE_API_KEY secret.
customProviders.name: TypeSafe AI (Jev)

inputs.description: Public hostname: crm-app.<subdomain>.workers.dev or a hostname on your zone
inputs.name: HOSTNAME

inputs.description: Identity adapter: Better Auth (email and password) or Cloudflare Access
inputs.name: IDENTITY_PROVIDER

inputs.description: Let anyone sign up (true), or only the first user (false)
inputs.name: AUTH_ALLOW_SIGNUP

inputs.description: Approval-policy floor no preset can loosen (JSON, ADR 0011)
inputs.name: APPROVAL_FLOOR

inputs.description: The packs this deployment installs: "*" the release product's own packs, a comma-separated list of packs the release carries, or "" for none (set by cos deploy, ADR 0422)
inputs.name: COS_PACKS

inputs.description: sha256 of the org's own extensions in the BLOBS bucket, installed as shipped (set by cos deploy, ADR 0422)
inputs.name: COS_ORG_EXTENSIONS

inputs.description: AI Gateway every model call goes through (usage and spend per role, BYOK)
inputs.name: AI_GATEWAY_ID

inputs.description: Deploy-config layer of the model registry: a preset (create-composable-os --model-roles) or JSON (ADR 0150, ADR 0192)
inputs.name: AI_MODEL_ROLES

inputs.description: true when AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN can call Workers AI: Workers AI then goes over REST through the gateway with payload logging off (set by the installer, ADR 0330)
inputs.name: AI_GATEWAY_REST

inputs.description: Providers whose key AI Gateway holds as BYOK, comma-separated (ADR 0192)
inputs.name: AI_GATEWAY_BYOK

inputs.description: true when AI Gateway holds the judge's TypeSafe key as BYOK under custom-typesafe (create-composable-os --provider-key typesafe=…, ADR 0230)
inputs.name: JUDGE_BYOK

inputs.description: Deploy layer of the judge's placement switches, JSON { "<placement>": true | false } (ADR 0230, ADR 0232)
inputs.name: JUDGE_PLACEMENTS

inputs.description: Hosted SaaS only: the control plane's Ed25519 public key (raw, base64url) for support-access tokens; empty means no support access (ADR 0212)
inputs.name: COS_SUPPORT_PUBLIC_KEY

secrets.description: The AI Gateway token (an account token with AI Gateway Run and Workers AI Read), sent as cf-aig-authorization, and for Workers AI over REST through the gateway with payload logging off. Generated by the installer and the updater (ADR 0180, ADR 0330).
secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN

secrets.description: Signs sessions. At least 32 random characters, e.g. the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`.
secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET

secrets.description: Public origin of the app, e.g. https://crm.example.com. Optional: inferred from requests when empty.
secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL

secrets.description: Only with IDENTITY_PROVIDER=cloudflare-access: the Access application's AUD tag.
secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_AUD

secrets.description: Only with IDENTITY_PROVIDER=cloudflare-access: your team domain.
secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN

secrets.description: Optional. Settings → AI's Cloudflare API token: provider keys as Workers secrets, AI Gateway usage (docs/deploying.md, In-app AI). Set from COS_AI_ADMIN_TOKEN.
secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

secrets.description: Optional. A scoped Cloudflare API token that lets Settings → Updates update this deployment itself (docs/deploying.md). Without it, updates use the `cos upgrade` CLI.
secrets.name: COS_UPDATE_TOKEN

secrets.description: Optional. The key the desk's codes, enrolled devices' credentials and desk session tokens are kept under (HMAC): at least 32 random characters, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. With DESK_HOSTNAME, turns on signing at the desk (Settings → Devices).
secrets.name: DESK_SECRET

secrets.description: Optional. Google OAuth client ID for Google sign-in.
secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID

secrets.description: Optional. Google OAuth client secret for Google sign-in.
secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

secrets.description: Optional. Videos in Cloudflare Stream (stage 42, ADR 0475): an account API token with Stream Write only, for direct uploads, states, captions and deletion. Set by a person (docs/stream-runbook.md); without it and STREAM_SIGNING_JWK video is not configured.
secrets.name: STREAM_API_TOKEN

secrets.description: Optional. The Stream signing key's JWK, as POST /stream/keys returns it (base64): the host signs each playback token with it. Set by a person (docs/stream-runbook.md), with the STREAM_SIGNING_KEY_ID var.
secrets.name: STREAM_SIGNING_JWK

secrets.description: Optional. The Turnstile widget's site key (stage 29, ADR 0728) that the host's form page (/f/<slug>, on the host's address and on a web app's site through its binding) draws for a public form. Not secret: kept as one so it stays out of wrangler.jsonc and each deploy keeps it. Set by a person beside TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY on cos-runner (docs/deploying.md, Forms: Turnstile).
secrets.name: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY

secrets.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile's secret key (stage 29, ADR 0722): forms check a visitor's spam token with it, and without it take no answers from people who are not signed in. Set by a person (docs/deploying.md, Forms: Turnstile); never stored in D1.
secrets.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY

secrets.description: Google (Web application) OAuth client ID
secrets.name: CLIENT_ID

secrets.description: Google (Web application) OAuth client secret
secrets.name: CLIENT_SECRET

secrets.description: Pub/Sub topic for Google Chat push hooks
secrets.name: PUBSUB_CHAT_TOPIC

secrets.description: Pub/Sub topic for Gmail push hooks
secrets.name: PUBSUB_GMAIL_TOPIC

secrets.description: Service account that signs Pub/Sub pushes
secrets.name: PUBSUB_PUSH_SERVICE_ACCOUNT

secrets.description: Microsoft Entra ID app OAuth client ID
secrets.name: CLIENT_ID

secrets.description: Microsoft Entra ID app OAuth client secret
secrets.name: CLIENT_SECRET

secrets.description: Signing secret of the fake payment provider's webhook (/in/fake). Generated by the installer and cos deploy when PAYMENTS_FAKE_PROVIDER is on (only in an environment marked live: false) and none is set; kept by later deploys. Without it the fake runs on localhost only.
secrets.name: FAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET

secrets.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_live_… or a restricted key with Checkout Sessions and Refunds write). Without it the Stripe payment account is refused.
secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY

secrets.description: Signing secret (whsec_…) of the Stripe webhook endpoint that posts to <BASE_URL>/in/stripe.
secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET

secrets.description: Slack app OAuth client ID
secrets.name: CLIENT_ID

secrets.description: Slack app OAuth client secret
secrets.name: CLIENT_SECRET

secrets.description: Slack app (the same app as gatekeeper-slack) OAuth client ID
secrets.name: CLIENT_ID

secrets.description: Slack app (the same app as gatekeeper-slack) OAuth client secret
secrets.name: CLIENT_SECRET

secrets.description: Signing secret of the fake text provider's webhook (/in/fake). Generated by the installer and cos deploy when TEXT_PROVIDER is fake (only in an environment marked live: false) and none is set; kept by later deploys. Without it the fake runs on localhost only.
secrets.name: FAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET

secrets.description: ZoomInfo OAuth client ID
secrets.name: CLIENT_ID

secrets.description: ZoomInfo OAuth client secret
